title: Permutation & Randomization Tests
interviewAnswer: A permutation test builds a null distribution by shuffling labels in a way justified by exchangeability under the null. It is especially useful for transparent nonparametric testing.
keyPoints: Shuffle only under a valid exchangeability assumption.
p-value is the tail probability under the randomization/null procedure.
why: Permutation & Randomization Tests appears frequently in data-science work because it connects mathematical assumptions to practical decisions, diagnostics and failure modes.
deepDive: A permutation test builds a null distribution by shuffling labels in a way justified by exchangeability under the null. It is especially useful for transparent nonparametric testing. Shuffle only under a valid exchangeability assumption. p-value is the tail probability under the randomization/null procedure. A strong practitioner separates the modeling assumption from the estimation procedure, checks diagnostics rather than trusting a single score, and explains what would make the method inappropriate.
workedExample: Shuffle treatment labels to test whether an observed conversion-rate difference is larger than random assignment would produce.
commonMistakes: Applying the method without checking its assumptions or data-generating process.
Choosing it because it is familiar rather than comparing against an appropriate baseline.
